extDescription.message: Makes QR codes on web pages clickable. Works on screens shared in Teams, Google Meet and Zoom too.

popupShortcut.message: $1 enters and leaves aim mode as well.

popupShortcutNone.message: You can assign a keyboard shortcut of your choosing for entering and leaving aim mode.

howToFine.message: Move the crosshair one pixel at a time

errorNoTab.message: No active tab could be found.

errorInjection.message: Aim mode cannot run on this page. Chrome's own settings and extension pages, and the Chrome Web Store, are off limits to extensions.

errorStartFailed.message: Aim mode could not be started.

optionsAutoSave.message: Changes are saved as you make them.

optionsAutoOpenLabel.message: Open the captured image in a new tab every time

optionsAutoOpenNote.message: You can open it any time from the panel that appears after reading, so leaving this off loses nothing. Keep it off if you would rather not have tabs switch during a meeting.

optionsShortcutBody.message: $1 enters and leaves aim mode. Open Chrome's shortcut settings to change it.

optionsShortcutNone.message: You can assign a keyboard shortcut of your choosing for entering and leaving aim mode. None is assigned at the moment.

optionsPrivacy1.message: Everything happens inside your browser. No image and no URL is ever sent anywhere.

optionsPrivacy2.message: Captured images, what was read, and where you pointed are all discarded. The only thing saved is the settings on this page.

optionsPrivacy3.message: A single frame is captured at the moment you confirm a position — never continuously.

debugIntro.message: This page shows what happened when something would not read. The position you pointed at, the area that was actually captured, and any QR code found are drawn on top of each other.

debugNoImage.message: There is nothing to show. Point at a position in aim mode first, then open this page.

debugImageAlt.message: The area captured around the position you pointed at

debugNoCode.message: No QR code was found in this area.

debugInsidePoint.message: under the position you pointed at

debugNotUrl.message: Not http or https, so no open button is offered.

debugCropLocated.message: the outline of what you pointed at

debugCropLadder.message: growing squares around where you pointed

debugClamped.message: Area was kept within the screen because it ran off the edge

debugHandling1.message: It exists only in your browser's memory. It is never written to a file.

debugHandling2.message: It is lost once the extension goes idle, or when Chrome restarts.

debugHandling3.message: It is never sent anywhere. screink declares no external hosts at all.

overlayBarHint.message: Click, or use the arrow keys and Enter. Press Esc to leave.

overlayCatcherLabel.message: screink aim mode: point at the QR code you want to read

overlayBodyNotFound.message: Check that you are pointing at the QR code itself.

overlayFarFromPoint.message: This one sits a little away from where you pointed

overlayCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the text above and copy it yourself.

overlayUnsafeUrl.message: This URL will not be opened. Only http and https are ever opened.

overlayOpenFailed.message: The URL could not be opened.

overlayInspectFailed.message: The captured image could not be opened.

overlayFailCapture.message: The screen could not be captured. Check that the tab is visible.

overlayFailMessaging.message: The extension could not talk to itself. Reload the extension.

overlayFailUnknown.message: The cause could not be determined.
